meta.name: Love 2016
meta.description: Rebellious Mickey and good-natured Gus navigate the thrills and agonies of modern relationships.

videos.title: It Begins
videos.overview: While recovering from nasty breakups with their exes, Mickey makes a scene at a church and Gus stumbles into a confusing sexual encounter.

videos.title: One Long Day
videos.overview: After Gus steps in to help Mickey out of a jam, the two end up on a bizarre odyssey through the streets of L.A.

videos.title: Tested
videos.overview: Gus faces a make-or-break situation at work, while Mickey navigates a dicey new dynamic with her boss.

videos.title: Party in the Hills
videos.overview: Mix-ups and meltdowns abound when Mickey invites Gus to a party and comes face-to-face with mistakes from her past.

videos.title: The Date
videos.overview: As Mickey tries to get her life back on track, Gus takes his date with Bertie to hilarious extremes.

videos.title: Andy
videos.overview: A newly confident Gus turns heads on set, while a disturbing day at the radio station leaves Mickey feeling reckless.

videos.title: Magic
videos.overview: Gus sets out to dazzle Mickey on their first real date, but the night doesn't go quite as he planned.

videos.title: Closing Title Song
videos.overview: As Mickey frets over the fallout from their date, a new guest shakes things up at Gus's movie night jam session.

videos.title: The Table Read
videos.overview: Gus gets exciting news at work, but a surprise visit from Mickey sends the day spiraling in a new direction.

videos.title: The End of the Beginning
videos.overview: Troubles keep mounting for Gus as he gets a taste of life in the writers' room. Meanwhile, a new crisis pushes Mickey to the breaking point.

videos.title: On Lockdown
videos.overview: After coming clean to Gus, Mickey tries to head home to decompress. But an unexpected turn of events keeps them out together late into the night.

videos.title: Friends Night Out
videos.overview: While Gus heads to a bar with his guy friends, a restless Mickey stirs up trouble at a dinner party full of couples.

videos.title: While You Were Sleeping
videos.overview: Mickey tries to help her work buddy Truman out of a sticky situation, and an on-set accident rattles the "Witchita" cast and crew.

videos.title: Shrooms
videos.overview: A quiet night turns trippy when Mickey convinces Gus, Bertie and Randy to sample her leftover psychedelic mushrooms.

videos.title: A Day
videos.overview: On a day of spontaneous adventures, Mickey and Gus open up about their pasts and begin to let go of their fears.

videos.title: Forced Hiatus
videos.overview: Big news on the "Witchita" set leaves Gus caught in the middle of a family dispute over Arya's future. Mickey grows suspicious of Randy's motives.

videos.title: The Work Party
videos.overview: While Mickey schmoozes with her new corporate bosses at a radio station party, Gus strikes up an unlikely friendship with Dr. Greg.

videos.title: Marty Dobbs
videos.overview: Gus joins Mickey for an outing with her dad but soon realizes the father-daughter dynamic is more complicated than she let on.

videos.title: Housesitting
videos.overview: While housesitting at a friend's mansion, Gus and Mickey host a "Witchita" viewing party. But brewing tensions threaten to spoil the fun.

videos.title: Liberty Down
videos.overview: As Gus heads off to the set of Arya's action film and Mickey dives into a big project at work, new cracks appear in their relationship.

videos.title: The Long D
videos.overview: Mickey bonds with her ex, while Gus makes a desperate bid to patch things up with the film director. Bertie has a revelation.

videos.title: Back in Town
videos.overview: With Gus back home, Mickey realizes she needs to make a decision. But her attempt to straighten out her love life only creates more chaos.

videos.title: Palm Springs Getaway
videos.overview: Randy pressures Mickey, Gus and Bertie into a couples weekend at his cousin's sweet Palm Springs pad. But nothing about the house is as advertised.

videos.title: Winners and Losers
videos.overview: While Mickey rides a wave of good news at work, Gus tries to spread some cheer around the tense "Witchita" set -- with demoralizing results.

videos.title: Arya and Greg
videos.overview: Gus helps a stressed-out Arya gear up for a big scene, while Mickey tries to salvage Dr. Greg's disastrous book-signing event.

videos.title: I'm Sick
videos.overview: Gus realizes he's facing a major relationship test when Mickey falls sick just as he's heading out on a horror movie location tour with friends.

videos.title: Bertie's Birthday
videos.overview: After a disappointing start to her first birthday in America, Bertie winds up on an action-packed LA adventure with a kindred spirit.

videos.title: Directing
videos.overview: Gus struggles to keep the actors and crew on task as he starts shooting his movie. Mickey sets out to show an old friend she's changed.

videos.title: Sarah from College
videos.overview: When Gus bumps into an ex at a wedding, Mickey realizes there's a lot she still doesn't know about his past.

videos.title: Stunt Show
videos.overview: A stunt audition inspires Chris to reconnect with Bertie. Dr. Greg begs for a spot on Stella’s show, and Gus asks Arya for a favor.

videos.title: You're My Gran Torino
videos.overview: As Gus prepares for his band's first gig and a trip back home to South Dakota, Mickey wonders if it’s time for her to meet the Cruikshank clan.

videos.title: The Cruikshanks
videos.overview: Back in the land of guns, cornhole and pickle wheels, Gus makes a critical relationship blunder. A plumbing crisis turns awkward for Bertie.

videos.title: Anniversary Party
videos.overview: Gus scrambles to stop Mickey from skipping town before his parents' party. But the day only yields more embarrassing revelations about his past.

videos.title: Catalina
videos.overview: As Mickey and Gus think seriously about their future, a spontaneous trip to Catalina Island brings together a motley group of their friends.
